rfps.name: MA DCR — Health/Safety & Environmental/Compliance Certification & Training (Category 2 subset)
rfps.decision: Pursue Category 2 narrow subset only (OSHA Construction Outreach, HAZWOPER, LOTO, Fall Protection, Hot Works, Chain Saw Safety, Reasonable Suspicion Training). SBPP in-state preference noted as competitive headwind.
